title: Review worker asks before landing a loop's design change when merging is on
notes: When merging is on (autoMerge, ship-decision-1), reviewPrompt's land steps (src/main/ship/review.ts:144-156) run pr land once the loop has converged, and nothing checks whether a round changed what the card asked for. A #329-style swap of the card's rule then merges with nobody asked, the outcome #338 prevents only where main lands. Fix: stop before pr land on such a change and report it to main. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/339 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/338#discussion_r4627908449

comments.body: This card is GitHub issue #339; the PR says Closes #339.
Pull request #368 opened: Review pane asks before landing a loop's design change when merging is on https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/368

Review loop on #368 converged in 2 rounds, ready to merge. Round 1 posted 2 findings, and fix commit 5431f058 addressed both: the review pane now reads the card (board show) before it judges a round, and step 4 on both forges says to name a design change on the card and to main. Round 2's re-review was clean. There was no conflict with main, and nothing is open or waiting on a person. CI passed on 5431f058. No round changed what the card asked for or its design.
